project.name: Community garden
project.description:
# Community garden

A Python library (no UI yet) that runs a neighborhood community garden.

- The garden has numbered plots in three sizes: small, medium and large. Members rent one plot per
  season (seasons are named like "2027-spring"). A member can rent at most one plot per season,
  and a plot can only be rented by one member per season.
- Season fees: small $40, medium $65, large $90. Members who rented any plot in the previous season
  get 10% off (seasons go spring, summer, fall, then the next year's spring). Seniors get $15 off
  after any other discount. Fees never go below $0. Money is in whole cents, rounded half up.
- When a season is full, members can join a waitlist for a plot size. When a rental is cancelled,
  the plot goes to the earliest waitlisted member for that size who doesn't already have a plot
  that season.
- Shared tools are watered on a rota: given the members renting in a season and the season's start
  date, produce a weekly watering schedule (one member per week, in order of plot number, wrapping
  around) for a given number of weeks.
- Staff need a season summary: plots rented by size, total fees collected, and waitlist length per size.

tasks.title: Season parsing and ordering
tasks.spec: Implement parse_season, format_season, previous_season and season_sort_key exactly as the docstrings in seasons.py. Season strings are 'YYYY-term' with term in spring, summer, fall; anything else raises InvalidSeasonError (message: 'Season must look like 2027-spring (spring, summer or fall).'). previous_season('2027-spring')=='2026-fall', ('2027-summer')->'2027-spring', ('2027-fall')->'2027-summer'; '0000-spring' raises. season_sort_key orders by (year, term index spring=0, summer=1, fall=2). Tests: round trips, leading zeros, whitespace/uppercase rejected, non-str rejected, year boundaries.

tasks.title: Season fee calculation
tasks.spec: Implement base_fee_cents and calculate_fee_cents exactly as the docstrings in pricing.py. Base fees in cents: small 4000, medium 6500, large 9000. Order: 10% loyalty discount if rented_previous_season (discount = round half up of amount*10/100 to the cent), then 1500 cents senior discount if is_senior, then floor at 0. Examples: LARGE/prev/not senior=8100; SMALL/prev/senior=2100; SMALL/no prev/senior=2500; MEDIUM/no prev/no senior=6500. Unknown size raises ValueError('Unknown plot size'). Tests should cover every size x flag combination and rounding of half cents.

tasks.title: Per-season waitlists
tasks.spec: Implement class Waitlist exactly as the docstrings in waitlist.py: add, remove, remove_member, entries, length, pop_next_eligible. Entries per (season, size) are kept in join order using a joined_order counter starting at 1 per instance. Duplicate (season,size,member_id) add raises WaitlistError('Already on the waitlist for that size'); remove of a missing entry raises WaitlistError('Not on the waitlist for that size'); remove_member never raises and returns the count removed. pop_next_eligible removes and returns the earliest entry whose member_id is not in the ineligible ids, or returns None and removes nothing. This module does not validate season strings. Tests: ordering, isolation across seasons and sizes, skipping ineligible members.

tasks.title: Garden rentals, cancellations and waitlist promotion
tasks.spec: Implement class Garden exactly as the docstrings in garden.py: __init__ (validates plot numbers), plots, waitlist, free_plots, rentals, quote_fee_cents, rent_plot, cancel_rental, join_waitlist. Fees come from pricing.calculate_fee_cents with rented_previous_season = member has an active rental in seasons.previous_season(season). Seasons are validated with seasons.parse_season. Check order and error types as in the docstrings (UnknownPlotError, PlotTakenError, AlreadyRentedError, NotRentedError, WaitlistError, InvalidSeasonError). cancel_rental promotes the earliest eligible waitlisted member for that plot's size (Waitlist.pop_next_eligible) onto the freed plot and returns their Rental, or None. A member who holds a plot gets all their waitlist entries for that season removed. Tests: the full rent/cancel/promote flow, fee on promotion, join rejected while a plot of that size is free.

tasks.title: Shared-tool watering rota
tasks.spec: Implement watering_schedule exactly as the docstring in watering.py. Negative weeks raises ScheduleError('Number of weeks cannot be negative'); weeks == 0 returns []; no rentals with weeks > 0 raises ScheduleError('No members are renting plots this season'). Otherwise sort rentals by plot_number ascending and assign week k (1-based) to the rental at index (k-1) % n, with week_start = start + 7*(k-1) days. Tests: wrap-around, unsorted input, start date arithmetic across months and years, single renter.

tasks.title: Season summary report
tasks.spec: Implement season_summary exactly as the docstring in reports.py. Validate season with seasons.parse_season (InvalidSeasonError). Count only rentals whose season equals the given season. Return SeasonSummary with plots_rented_by_size, total_fees_cents, and waitlist_length_by_size, each keyed by all three PlotSize values in SMALL, MEDIUM, LARGE order and zero-filled. Pure function, no mutation. Tests: empty season, mixed seasons ignored, waitlist lengths per size.
